title: Counterfoil Continuum: An AI Revenue Operating Layer for the Experience Economy
excerpts: Ternary built Continuum, a foundational RevOps layer that unifies pricing, inventory, and distribution decisions for experience-economy operators—turning fragmented, manual workflows into a coordinated, policy-safe revenue system.

contentBlocks.heading: Overview
paras: Continuum is positioned as a foundational revenue-operations layer, not a standalone pricing feature. It unifies the decision-critical workflows that span pricing, inventory, and distribution, giving operators a single control plane over the levers that drive yield.
The platform is built to support heterogeneous operators while holding consistent governance and extensibility, so it adapts to each business without fragmenting the underlying model.

contentBlocks.heading: Client & Segment
paras: The client serves operators in the experience economy—attractions, activities, and tours—who routinely run revenue operations across fragmented tooling.
This segment needs real-time coordination across channels and products without sacrificing policy control.

contentBlocks.heading: Problem
paras: Operators faced fragmented decision paths, manual interventions, and limited visibility into how pricing and channel actions interacted with inventory constraints.
The absence of a unified control layer produced yield leakage, slower response times, and inconsistent operational execution.

contentBlocks.heading: Solution
paras: Ternary implemented a modular, API-first, event-driven platform that pairs configurable business rules with model-assisted recommendations.
The architecture preserves operator control through explicit policy boundaries and override-capable workflows, enabling faster and more consistent decisioning without removing human judgment.

contentBlocks.heading: Impact
paras: Continuum established a scalable operating foundation that connects previously siloed revenue levers and supports ongoing product evolution.
Public quantitative metrics are not disclosed, but the delivered platform materially improves operational coherence and readiness for optimization at scale.

contentBlocks.heading: Tech Stack
paras: A modular service architecture with API-based integration interfaces and event-driven orchestration.
Governed decisioning that pairs deterministic rule frameworks with AI-assisted recommendations.

contentBlocks.heading: Why It Matters
paras: In the experience economy, margin and growth depend on fast, policy-safe decisions across volatile demand.
Continuum turns disconnected operational tasks into a coordinated revenue system, creating a stronger base for both day-to-day execution and long-term strategic optimization.

title: Turfly: A Sports-Facility Booking Marketplace
excerpts: Ternary built Turfly, a sports-facility booking marketplace that gives players instant confirmation and gives turf operators utilization optimization, dynamic pricing, and real-time demand visibility—cutting booking time by 60% with 85% mobile adoption in 30 days.

contentBlocks.heading: Overview
paras: Turfly is a sports-facility booking marketplace that connects players seeking instant, confirmed bookings with turf operators who need to maximize utilization and revenue.

Ternary's role was to move the initiative from concept to a production marketplace—real-time availability, integrated payments, and dynamic pricing in a single platform built for Bangladesh's market conditions.

contentBlocks.heading: Client & Segment
paras: A sports-facility marketplace serving two sides: players who need instant booking confirmation, and turf operators who require utilization optimization, dynamic pricing, and demand visibility.

contentBlocks.heading: Problem
paras: Sports-facility booking in Bangladesh relied on fragmented manual processes, phone-based availability checks, and delayed confirmations.

Operators faced low utilization, revenue leakage from booking errors, and zero real-time demand visibility. The market needed instant confirmation, integrated payments across a fragmented payment landscape, and dynamic pricing that adjusts to demand patterns.

contentBlocks.heading: Solution
paras: Ternary built the end-to-end platform: Flutter mobile apps for players, a React web portal for operators, and a FastAPI backend with AI-powered booking recommendations.

The platform includes smart search with ML-ranked results, real-time availability and one-tap booking, integrated multi-provider payments, dynamic pricing tied to demand, and real-time analytics dashboards for operators.

contentBlocks.heading: Impact
paras: Turfly reduced booking time by 60% and achieved 95%+ policy compliance.
Mobile adoption reached 85% within 30 days, giving operators real-time spend and demand visibility, automated booking flows, and unified bookings, payments, and reconciliation.

contentBlocks.heading: Tech Stack
paras: Flutter mobile apps, a React web portal, FastAPI backend services, PostgreSQL and Redis for data, and an ML recommendation engine for booking optimization.
AWS infrastructure with S3 storage, multi-provider payment integrations, and real-time analytics with Elasticsearch.

contentBlocks.heading: Why It Matters
paras: AI and automation can transform operations while keeping operators in control.
Turfly aligns the player experience with operator economics, unlocking value from booking data, demand intelligence, and dynamic pricing as the marketplace scales.

title: Alley Analytix: A Portable Coaching-Intelligence Platform for Performance Bowling
excerpts: Ternary engineered Alley Analytix end to end—from custom finger-grip sensor hardware to a scalable cloud platform and AI coaching assistant—proving that portable analytics and analytical fidelity can coexist for competitive bowling.

contentBlocks.heading: Overview
paras: Alley Analytix is a performance-intelligence platform that combines portable sensor technology with AI-driven coaching analytics for competitive bowling.
Ternary engineered the complete product—from prototype telemetry hardware to a production-ready system that serves players and coaches with real-time performance insights.

contentBlocks.heading: Client & Segment
paras: Alley Analytix operates in sports-performance technology for competitive bowling.

The product serves two stakeholders: players who need real-time feedback on throw mechanics—speed, RPM, phase-state—and coaches who need longitudinal performance tracking and actionable training insights.

contentBlocks.heading: Problem
paras: Bowling analytics relied on expensive fixed infrastructure, limiting accessibility. Players and coaches needed performance data without prohibitive costs or stationary-system constraints.

Existing solutions forced a trade-off between affordability and analytical fidelity. The market needed portable technology that preserves signal quality while delivering coaching intelligence—not just raw telemetry.

contentBlocks.heading: Solution
paras: Ternary built the end-to-end platform: purpose-built finger-grip hardware, real-time sensor processing for motion analytics, cloud infrastructure for high-concurrency ingestion, and coaching dashboards for longitudinal tracking.
A context-aware AI assistant translates raw data into coaching recommendations. The system includes OTA firmware updates and scalable analytics supporting thousands of simultaneous players.

contentBlocks.heading: Impact
paras: Alley Analytix shifts bowling analytics from fixed installations to portable coaching intelligence, using miniaturized finger-grip hardware that preserves signal fidelity for longitudinal tracking.
An AI assistant provides context-aware coaching support, all on a scalable cloud architecture built for growth.

contentBlocks.heading: Tech Stack
paras: Custom embedded hardware (a finger-grip sensor), real-time motion processing, cloud data ingestion, and coaching dashboards.
An AI assistant, OTA firmware updates, a scalable analytics platform, and mobile and web interfaces.

contentBlocks.heading: Why It Matters
paras: Alley Analytix combines co-designed hardware and intelligent software to deliver accessible, precise performance analytics for a niche sport.
It demonstrates that portability and analytical accuracy are mutually achievable—paving the way for multi-sport expansion and richer coaching data.

title: FAROGL: Re-architecting Enterprise Operations With an Odoo-Centered ERP Program
excerpts: Ternary delivered a phased, Odoo-centered ERP program for an oil-and-gas operator—treating ERP as an operating-model transformation that codifies process controls, governance, and consistency across critical business functions.

contentBlocks.heading: Overview
paras: This engagement positioned ERP as an enterprise operating-model transformation, not a narrow software installation.
The work focused on codifying process controls and operational consistency across critical business functions.

contentBlocks.heading: Client & Segment
paras: The client, FAROGL, operates in oil and gas, where financial accuracy, approval rigor, and cross-functional process traceability are core operating requirements.
The segment demands systems that can scale without weakening governance.

contentBlocks.heading: Problem
paras: FAROGL faced fragmented workflows and inconsistent process enforcement across key operational areas.
Manual handoffs and disconnected practices increased reconciliation effort, slowed cycle times, and constrained enterprise-level visibility.

contentBlocks.heading: Solution
paras: Ternary executed a phased Odoo program beginning with structured requirements discovery, management alignment, and process-baseline definition.
Module planning and implementation were mapped to validated workflows, with selective configuration and controlled extension to preserve maintainability and adoption quality.

contentBlocks.heading: Impact
paras: The program established a coherent ERP foundation and a lower-risk path for enterprise-wide standardization.
Public quantitative KPIs are not disclosed, but the delivered approach materially improves process clarity, governance confidence, and readiness for broader digital scaling.

contentBlocks.heading: Tech Stack
paras: Centered on Odoo with a phased delivery model.
The model combines requirements engineering, process mapping, backlog-driven implementation, and readiness validation.

contentBlocks.heading: Why It Matters
paras: In control-sensitive industries, ERP value comes from reliable process behavior and sustained adoption—not feature volume.
This implementation created the operational backbone required for disciplined execution and future transformation.

title: DoYouWork: Transforming Field-Service Operations With an Integrated Employee Platform
excerpts: Ternary built DoYouWork, a unified mobile and admin platform for Amistee's field-service operations—consolidating scheduling, asset management, and approvals into a single, multi-tenant, real-time system that replaces fragmented tools and paperwork.

contentBlocks.heading: Overview
paras: DoYouWork is a unified mobile and admin platform built to replace fragmented tools and manual processes in field-service operations.
Ternary's role was to consolidate scheduling, asset management, and workflow approvals into a scalable, single-source system.

contentBlocks.heading: Client & Segment
paras: Amistee Air Duct, Insulation & Cleaning—Novi, Michigan; field service.
The client needed a solution that serves both field employees requiring self-service tools and managers needing centralized, real-time operational visibility.

contentBlocks.heading: Problem
paras: Field-service managers lacked a real-time, unified view of daily operations—schedules, vehicle assignments, and approval statuses.
Employees had no self-service for essential requests such as expenses, spiffs, time-off, and tools or clothing, relying instead on slow paperwork.

contentBlocks.heading: Solution
paras: Ternary delivered a three-app ecosystem: a native-quality mobile employee app built with Capacitor, a web admin portal for managers, and a scalable FastAPI backend.
Features include role-based access control, location-based data scoping, multi-tenant architecture, real-time WebSocket notifications, and secure AWS S3 integration for approval workflows.

contentBlocks.heading: Impact
paras: The platform launched a unified, mobile-first digital system, replacing manual processes with real-time operational visibility and location-based manager approvals.
With robust RBAC and multi-tenancy, the self-service solution provides a scalable, extensible foundation for future growth—particularly for field technicians.

contentBlocks.heading: Tech Stack
paras: React 19 for the web portal, Capacitor for the mobile application, and FastAPI for the backend API.
PostgreSQL as the primary database, Redis for caching and sessions, and AWS for hosting and file storage.

contentBlocks.heading: Why It Matters
paras: Platform consolidation in field service immediately delivers real-time operational visibility and workflow efficiency.
It replaces fragmented tools and paper-based processes with a single, accountable source of truth.

Program-level KPI targets are defined in requirements, but publicly verified realized metrics are not disclosed in the available source material.

Secure integration touchpoints across core systems, plus app-layer governance controls for auditability and operational reliability.

title: LankaBangla Securities: An Air-Gapped LLM Application Layer
excerpts: Ternary deployed an air-gapped open-source LLM environment for a capital-markets firm and built the extensible application layer over it—delivering an AI assistant for dealer-brokers and behavior-aware retail marketing with control at the infrastructure boundary.

contentBlocks.heading: Overview
paras: Ternary's mandate was to deploy an air-gapped open-source LLM environment and build the extensible application layer that mediates end-user interaction with AI capabilities.
The engagement was designed to deliver institutional control and practical workflow value at the same time.

contentBlocks.heading: Client & Segment
paras: The client operates in capital markets, where data governance and execution speed are both critical.
This segment requires AI systems that are secure by architecture and directly useful in high-tempo operational decisions.

contentBlocks.heading: Problem
paras: Dealer-brokers needed faster access to synthesized information, while retail outreach required more relevance than generic campaign logic.
At the same time, AI deployment had to avoid uncontrolled data exposure and remain compatible with enterprise governance expectations.

contentBlocks.heading: Solution
paras: Ternary implemented a governed application layer over an air-gapped open-source LLM and shipped two initial functions.
The first is an AI assistant for dealer-brokers to retrieve and synthesize information quickly; the second is automated marketing for retail traders informed by trade behavior and account context.

contentBlocks.heading: Impact
paras: The result is a secure, extensible AI foundation with immediate business-facing functionality across brokerage productivity and retail engagement workflows.
Public quantitative impact metrics are not disclosed in the available source material.

contentBlocks.heading: Tech Stack
paras: An air-gapped open-source LLM runtime.
A reusable application layer for role-aware AI workflows and module-based functional expansion.

contentBlocks.heading: Why It Matters
paras: This implementation shows how financial institutions can operationalize AI safely.
Control sits at the infrastructure boundary, usefulness at the workflow boundary, and extensibility at the platform boundary.
